answer: Challenger-bounty bond: every new wallet locks 8 POA for 30 epochs, and any established wallet may pay a 0.5 POA fee to demand a live check where the owner signs a fresh message within 10 minutes. A failed check pays 6 POA to the challenger and burns 2 POA. An honest user only parks 8 POA, while 1,000 fakes lock 8,000 POA and lose 6,000 once challenged. Self-challenging still burns 2.5 POA per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost 2,500. Jurors verify each signature on the public ridge of records, and a ferrous silence from a refusing owner loses the bond; every voyage of the fee is traceable.
